ItemID: NA; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country-rock direction fits my interests, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Croz; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Reflective songwriting appeals to me, though it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Wild Feathers; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots rock sounds promising, but I need more familiarity before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Houses of the Holy 2014; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and songwriter records than heavier classic rock right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wings Over America; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A lengthy live album is not what I want for this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Physical Graffiti; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Despite my interest in Hendrix, I am not looking for a heavier rock album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Live at the Academy of Music 1971; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Band's roots-oriented sound appeals to me, but I would prioritize a studio record today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having listened to Old Sock, I would choose this for Clapton's relaxed blues and JJ Cale's songs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for the thoughtful songwriting and roots-oriented sound that appeal to me in You Should Be So Lucky.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less appealing than vocals and song-focused music right now.
